gloss: to be beaten to it; to be outdone; to have someone get ahead of you

definitions.gloss: to be beaten to it; to be outdone; to have someone get there first
definitions.explanation: Describes the experience of being surpassed or preempted by someone else who achieves something before you do. The passive form of {先|さき}を{越|こ}す (to get ahead of).

examples.japanese: ⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先|さき}を{越|こ}された。
examples.english: I was beaten to it by my rival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{告白|こくはく}しよう→告白する：19631_kokuhakusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先|さき}を{越|こ}された。
examples.english: I was going to confess my feelings, but my friend beat me to it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えていた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{他社|たしゃ}→他社：17803_tasha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先|さき}を{越|こ}されて⟦{商品化|しょうひんか}→商品化：30135_shouhinka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We had been thinking of the same idea, but another company beat us to it and brought the product to market.

notes:
The passive form of ⟦{先|さき}を{越|こ}す→先を越す：16921_sakiwokosu⟧ (to get ahead of, to outdo). Expresses frustration or disappointment at having been preempted by someone else.

ACTIVE FORM:
⟦{先|さき}を{越|こ}す→先を越す：16921_sakiwokosu⟧ means "to get ahead of" from the agent's perspective:
- ⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先|さき}を{越|こ}す→先を越す：16921_sakiwokosu⟧: to get ahead of one's rival

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先|さき}を{越|こ}される: to be beaten to it by ~
- {先|さき}を{越|こ}されまい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: determined not to be outdone
- {先|さき}を{越|こ}された{悔|くや}しさ: the frustration of being beaten to it

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出|で}し{抜|ぬ}かれる: to be outsmarted, outmaneuvered — implies cunning or trickery
- ⟦{追|お}い{越|こ}される→追い越す：04623_oikosu⟧: to be overtaken — more literal, often physical (passing in a race or on a road)
- ⟦{後塵|こうじん}を{拝|はい}する→後塵を拝する：22886_koujinwohaisuru⟧: to fall behind, to eat someone's dust — more literary and formal
